name: feature-recon
description: Reconnaissance sweep of any codebase, feature by feature: what works, what's broken, what's missing, what's untested. Emits one evidence-cited JSON state file per feature plus a rollup, renders a self-contained HTML dashboard, and turns the findings into ordered task files that update the report as fixes land. Optionally drives the running app in a real browser to confirm findings, and records narrated demo videos of the flows that pass.
